item_short_desc: The Cammenga .223 Easyloader Rifle Magazine Loader is ideal for fast loading of high capacity mags. It is impact proof fiberglass, and is designed to work in conjunction with the following rifle magazines: AR-15, M-16 & Mini-14.  Also comes with a lifetime guarantee.
